title: As We Sing This Song
credit: Written and sung by Rachel Grace Ham
lyrics: As we sing this song, we will sing along,
As the people sing, we will sing His song,
As we worship Him, Christ Jesus is His name,
We will sing unto Him, this song of worship, a song of praise.

title: Warmer Way Tonight
credit: Written and created by Mona Jackson-Ham (MJ)
lyrics: [Verse 1]
Evey, put the sharp words down
Rachel, let that heavy look fade
We don't have to turn a little spark
Into a fire that nobody made
Take a breath, count to four
Leave the old reaction at the door
A softer answer changes everything
When we choose what we're reaching for
[Pre-Chorus]
You can pause before you answer
You can listen, you can bend
Every moment is a doorway
To begin again
[Chorus]
Better attitude, better behavior
Give a little grace to your neighbor
Evey and Rachel, let the kindness show
The way you treat the world is the way you grow
Better attitude, better behavior
Make your hearts a little bit braver
No more cutting deep just to prove you're right
Choose a warmer way tonight
